The update check can now be turned off, and the website counts installs and Docker pulls instead of active installs.

### 🚀 Features
- **The update check is optional.** Set `PAPYRA_UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED: "false"` in your compose file and Papyra never makes its daily request or creates its install ID. Admins then won't see the update notice. [What is sent](https://papyra.app/docs/update-check)

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- Both compose files now carry `PAPYRA_UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED` (default `"true"`). It is listed on the [configuration page](https://papyra.app/docs/configuration).
- `GET /api/admin/update` also returns `turnedOff`.

### 🌐 Website
- The home page shows total installs and total Docker pulls. Active installs are no longer shown, and the wording now says "a count of installs".

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v1.1.0...v1.1.1](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1)
